checkpoint_reason: Reuse viable (R0), discovery stable (R3), and artefact retrieval for known artefacts deterministic (R4 partial) all pass; blocked on proving exact corpus enumeration (R1) and target-family artefact URL stability (R4).
blocking_to_go: Prove per-entity GET enumeration path (listaifi?nif= -> nreg -> descargaxbrlipp.ashx?t={GUID}; ListadoIFA?nif= -> registro oficial -> iXBRL) for SAN/BBVA/IBE.
Retrieve one real ESEF iXBRL and one IPP filing end-to-end, download twice out-of-session, compare SHA-256.
Characterise the ESEF ?e=<token> variant; if it changes per visit while yielding the same bytes, R4 remains FAIL and canonical identity must not rely on the URL.
known_source_risks: Registry-search postback not yielding rows (likely bypassable via per-entity GET path, still unproven).
Issuer-authored filings may carry third-party copyright not covered by CNMV reuse terms.
Entity sitemap is only a partial sample.
legal_constraints: Free private use and faithful reproduction permitted (condition 1).
Paid distribution must inform buyers the data is free at source (condition 2).
No framing; links must open in an independent window (condition 4).
reproducibility_result: Artefact-level deterministic (SHA-256 stable, out-of-session) for one GUID artefact + one taxonomy. Full corpus recovery pending enumeration (R1) and target-family URL stability (R4).
